import sys

def solve():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not input_data:
        return
    
    iterator = iter(input_data)
    n = int(next(iterator))
    
    p = [int(next(iterator)) for _ in range(n)]
    s = [int(next(iterator)) for _ in range(n)]
    
    pos_in_s = [0] * (n + 1)
    for idx, val in enumerate(s):
        pos_in_s[val] = idx
    
    current_p = list(p)
    ops = []

    for i in range(n):

            continue
        
        val = current_p[i]
        correct_pos = pos_in_s[val]
        
        if i > correct_pos:
            temp_idx = correct_pos
            while temp_idx < i:
                j = temp_idx
                swap_i, swap_j = i, j
                
                total_cost += abs(swap_i - swap_j)
                ops.append((swap_i + 1, swap_j + 1))
                
                current_p[swap_i], current_p[swap_j] = current_p[swap_j], current_p[swap_i]
                
                val_at_i = current_p[swap_i]
                val_at_j = current_p[swap_j]
                
                pos_in_s[val_at_i] = swap_i

                total_cost += abs(j - (j - 1))

                current_p[j], current_p[j - 1] = current_p[j - 1], current_p[j]
                
                val_at_j = current_p[j]

                pos_in_s[val_at_j] = j

            if current_p[i] != s[i]:
